column1: Requirement
The system shall allow users to register using their email address and a password.
The application must load the main dashboard within 1.5 seconds under normal conditions.
All passwords must be stored using bcrypt hashing with a minimum cost factor of 12.
The user interface shall follow the company's brand guidelines including colors and logo placement.
The system shall be deployable on both Windows Server 2019 and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
New users should be able to complete the registration process without any external help or documentation.
The system must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours.
The application shall support exporting reports in PDF and Excel formats.
The system shall handle at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
All API endpoints must require OAuth 2.0 token-based authentication.
Error messages shall be displayed in plain language that non-technical users can understand.
The system shall use a consistent color scheme with a maximum of five primary colors.
The application must be compatible with the latest versions of Chrome
The system shall send email notifications when a user's order status changes.
Response time for database queries shall not exceed 200 milliseconds for 95% of requests.
The source code must comply with the organization's coding standards and be peer-reviewed before deployment.
The system shall provide a search function that returns results ranked by relevance.
Two-factor authentication must be available for all administrator accounts.
The application shall support internationalization for at least English
The system must be able to recover from a server failure within 30 seconds without data loss.
